content.value: A project's capital cost is estimated at \$ 5000 spread over three years. (13) It is expected that \$ 3600 will be spent in the initial year and \$ 700 in each of the following two years. The benefit of the project is expected \$ 3000 for the 1st year and \$ 4000 for 2nd year. What are the Net Present Value (NPV) and Benefit Cost Ratio (BCR) of the project at 15% discount rate? What is the IRR of the project?
